text:
Nora Li: Heads-up: we applied a runtime pin on llama2q-prod in us-central as a precaution after the midnight rollout. Need decision: keep pin through morning rollforward or add an exemption so rollforward skips it.

DeployBot: Pin snapshot (6112240005): runtime_pin: llama2q-prod (region: us-central) reason: post-rollout instability author: Nora Li expires: 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z

Jamal: Telemetry looks noisy but theres a clear memory regression on batch=64 workloads. Canary failing.

Zoe (SRE): Agree. +1 to exempt and skip the model during rollforward. We should attach a rollback command in the pin metadata.

Priya: If we skip, please add the runbook link and set an explicit TTL. Also add a note to release notes so customers know we skipped a runtime for a model in that region.

Nora Li: Ok I'll create the exemption and add TTL=48h and runbook link. Approving skip by default; release-lead can override.

DeployBot: Running: deploybot pin add-exemption --model llama2q-prod --scope runtime --reason "post-rollout instability" --author "Nora Li" --expires "2026-03-22T03:00:00Z" --meta "rollback: deploybot runtime-rollback --to-image runtime-v2.13.4; runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llama2q_prod"

DeployBot: Exemption created id: ex-2412. Marked skip-on-rollforward.

Luis: Noted for release notes: "us-central rollforward: skipped runtime pin for llama2q-prod (investigating memory regression)". I'll add to the changelog draft.

Zoe (SRE): Added short alert window to #eng-sre for 24h and will re-evaluate tomorrow morning.

Nora Li: Thanks all. I'll post an update at 07:00 PT with metrics and next steps.
